verdict.rationale: Snowflake CLI runs keylessly and headlessly (verified via probe: `uvx snow --version`), and `snow sql` supports inline queries, file execution, and stdin piping for fully scripted, credential-driven automation — exactly the CI/agent workflow described. This is backed by REST APIs (SQL API, resource management API) for programmatic access without any UI. Missing for 10: independent third-party CI pipeline case studies or GitHub Actions examples showing this in production use, and no mention of official CI/CD templates (e.g., GitHub Actions marketplace action).
